clusters.name: Event venue rental
clusters.description: Lease or own a hall, house or distinctive property and rent it by the block for parties, weddings and events, with upsells.

clusters.name: Party equipment rentals
clusters.description: Rent party gear such as bounce houses, lawn games, tents, movie screens, heaters and treat machines to hosts and organizers, priced per event or day.

clusters.name: Event photo and novelty stations
clusters.description: Bring photo booths, aura photos, magnet stations and similar novelty add-ons to weddings and events, priced per event or session.

clusters.name: Mobile event beverage and dessert catering
clusters.description: Hire out a mobile coffee, soda, lemonade, beer or dessert bar for private, corporate and brand events, paid per event or per hour.

clusters.name: Food stall or cart at fairs and markets
clusters.description: Sell a niche food or drink item from a truck, cart or booth at fairs, festivals and farmers markets, earning per-item sales.

clusters.name: Backyard food pop-up
clusters.description: Take pre-orders and sell pizza, barbecue or griddle food from a home pop-up to local residents.

clusters.name: Pickleball membership club
clusters.description: Build or convert a local pickleball court venue and charge players for memberships and court bookings.

clusters.name: Pickleball leagues and tournaments
clusters.description: Organize local pickleball teams and tournaments for players and court owners.

clusters.name: Hosting fees for private sports courts
clusters.description: Charge coaches and instructors a fee to run lessons or clinics on a private court.

clusters.name: Pay-per-attempt skill challenge games
clusters.description: Run hole-in-one, basketball and other carnival-style skill games where players pay per attempt to try for a prize.

clusters.name: RC and dig-machine play attractions
clusters.description: Offer paid play sessions on RC or real construction machines in sandpits, through mobile trailers, stores, courses or cafes.

clusters.name: Mobile activity trailers for events
clusters.description: Bring a trailer-based activity such as woodworking, video games, basketball or light-up floor games to corporate and community events for a fee.

clusters.name: Indoor family play and game venue
clusters.description: Run a local play or interactive-game venue for families, earning from admissions, memberships and parties.

clusters.name: Themed ticketed social events
clusters.description: Run bingo-style themed party nights at venues and sell tickets, extra boards, food and drinks.

clusters.name: Audience-sold conferences and events
clusters.description: Sell tickets to in-person events, conferences, expos or retreats to an audience built through content or a community.

clusters.name: Community gatherings and festivals
clusters.description: Organize recurring in-person community gatherings or participatory festivals around a shared interest, often not run for profit.

clusters.name: Niche competition events
clusters.description: Stage niche competitions such as horse-haircut, Excel, coding, paintball or survival contests, earning from entry fees, tickets and sponsors.

clusters.name: Agritourism and rural land experiences
clusters.description: Monetize farm or rural land with petting days, u-pick fields, apiary tours, ticketed farm events and hunting, through tickets, fees and product sales.

clusters.name: Hosted group travel trips
clusters.description: Plan and sell end-to-end group trips to a destination for enthusiasts or party groups, priced as a package per group.

clusters.name: Local guided tours and charters
clusters.description: Sell ticketed local tours, themed location tours or party-boat charters to visitors and groups.

clusters.name: Adrenaline experience venue
clusters.description: Run a venue where customers pay for packages to drive tanks, fire weapons or ride machines over obstacles.

clusters.name: Surplus aircraft attractions
clusters.description: Buy decommissioned aircraft or simulators and monetize them as ride attractions or stays.

clusters.name: Organizing vendor markets
clusters.description: Organize recurring markets, including kids' and neighborhood markets, and charge vendors booth fees.

clusters.name: Sauna and cold plunge sessions
clusters.description: Run fixed or mobile saunas and cold plunges, earning from per-session access, private bookings and event fees.

clusters.name: Urban phone-free meditation room
clusters.description: Sell short timed sessions in a branded distraction-free meditation space to busy city residents.

clusters.name: Boutique event planning and setups
clusters.description: Plan and set up special-occasion experiences such as pet parties, luxury picnics and beach weddings, sold as per-event packages.

clusters.name: Novelty live performers
clusters.description: Book novelty performers, such as cheese fortune-telling or mariachi sales pitches, for individuals or corporate clients at a fee per session.

clusters.name: Celebrity paid speaking
clusters.description: Earn paid speaking fees from event organizers on the speaker circuit.

clusters.name: Fine-dining restaurant
clusters.description: Run a high-end tasting-menu restaurant earning from restaurant sales.

clusters.name: Event security staffing
clusters.description: Supply temporary licensed guards to event organizers and venues on contract.

clusters.name: Golf simulator franchise
clusters.description: Develop and sell franchised golf simulator locations.

clusters.name: Seasonal Christmas tree lot
clusters.description: Run a pop-up artificial and real Christmas tree lot selling to local families.

clusters.name: Correspondence chess by mail
clusters.description: Match chess players for games played by mail and charge a subscription.

clusters.name: Hands-on skills fantasy camps
clusters.description: Teach practical skills such as welding or basic repairs to non-handy adults in short classes paid per participant.

clusters.name: Niche hobby destination town
clusters.description: Make a small town the hub of a hobby niche, earning from retail, classes and tourism alongside online sales.

clusters.name: Gem-mining mall kiosk
clusters.description: Sell bags of dirt with gems for a panning activity at malls and tourist spots, priced per bag.

clusters.name: Disc golf course
clusters.description: Build a disc golf course funded by course fees or donations.
